rca of the issue: Vendor portal/scraper feature: playwright python package pinned to 1.40.0 (in requirements.txt) which auto-downloads chromium revision 1091. The container image only ships /pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1208 (likely from a newer playwright installed earlier and pruned, or installed as headless-shell only). When async_playwright().chromium.launch() runs, playwright looks for full chromium 1091 and fails. Two fixes: (a) run `playwright install chromium` to fetch 1091, OR (b) upgrade playwright to 1.48+ to use the existing 1208 binary. Option (a) is safer (no regressions in other code paths).
